title: Hanuman Temple Connaught Place | Timings, History & Travel Guide
content:
Hanuman Temple Connaught Place - Timings, History & Travel Guide,

Hanuman Temple in Connaught Place, Delhi, is one of the oldest and most famous temples dedicated to Lord Hanuman. Believed to have origins dating back to the Mahabharata, this temple holds deep spiritual importance and attracts thousands of devotees every week.

The temple is especially known for its tall idol of Lord Hanuman, visible from afar, and its walls inscribed with verses from the Sundar Kand of the Ramayana. Many devotees believe that praying here removes obstacles and brings blessings.

Special Days at Hanuman Temple: Tuesdays and Saturdays are the most significant days for Hanuman worship. On these days, the temple is filled with long queues of devotees, chanting, and offerings, creating a highly spiritual and energetic atmosphere.

Best Time to Visit: The temple can be visited throughout the year, but the best time is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant. Hanuman Temple is open daily from 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM and again from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest station is Rajiv Chowk (Blue/Yellow Line), a short walk from the temple.
  • By Bus/Auto: Easily accessible from anywhere in central Delhi.
  • By Car: Limited parking nearby—better to walk from Connaught Place.

Entry Fee:

Free for all visitors.

Travel Tip: If visiting on a Tuesday or Saturday, arrive early to avoid the longest queues - temple gets especially busy after 10 AM.

faqs.question: Where is Hanuman Temple located in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Hanuman Temple is located in Connaught Place (CP), central Delhi, one of the city’s busiest areas.

faqs.question: What is Hanuman Temple famous for?
faqs.answer: It is famous for its connection with the Mahabharata and its giant Hanuman idol.

faqs.question: What are the timings of Hanuman Temple Connaught Place?
faqs.answer: The temple is open daily from 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Which days are best to visit Hanuman Temple?
faqs.answer: Tuesdays and Saturdays are the most auspicious and spiritual days to visit.

faqs.question: How much time is needed to visit Hanuman Temple?
faqs.answer: On average, devotees spend 30 minutes to 1 hour offering prayers and exploring the temple.
